style: Avant-garde acoustic cabaret art-rock and industrial noise theater. Harmony is bitonal modal drone featuring microtonal beating between unstable reference frames and pentatonic sléndro spacing with overtone clashes. Melody employs angular cabaret patter equipped with lexical tone contours, rapid glottalized vowel leaps, and frantic spoken-word interruptions. Rhythm interlocks motorik pulses with asymmetric footstep group-stomp densities, pneumatic air releases, and stuttering clockwork fractions. Timbre deploys fluorescent ballast hum, shift-register noise, degraded magnetic tape loops, 8-bit pulse synth, cristal baschet, heavy thunder sheet resonance, scraped large sheet metal plates, and wet spring reverb tails. Performance executes trashy cheap theatrical spectacle strictly played straight underneath extreme panic-under-function survival pressure.
